detail.longDescription: Text editor/IDE for Windows : AmigaED 4.0 "AmigaED4" is a text editor and IDE featuring integration with gcc, vbcc, and SAS/C, designed specifically for assembler and C/C++ programmers who want to develop software for AmigaOS. In addition to syntax highlighting and project management features, it also offers the ability to run compiled projects directly in the emulator. Versions are available for Windows and Linux (Ubuntu, Debian). https://www. amiga-news.de/en/news/AN-2026- 10-00082-EN.html # Editor # Amiga # IDE # programming
